Container.Name: eve-flipper
Container.Overview:
EVE Online market intelligence, station trading, industry planning, and portfolio tooling. Local-first: talks to ESI directly from your Unraid server and stores everything under /data. Access the UI in a browser at http://[IP]:[PORT:13370] once running. First launch downloads the Static Data Export (~50 MB) — expect a couple of minutes before the scanner is ready.
Before first login, register a second callback URL on developers.eveonline.com for your Eve Flipper application — for example http://unraid.local:13370/api/auth/callback — and match it in the ESI Callback URL field below. See https://github.com/stevarms/Eve-flipper/blob/master/DOCKER.md for full instructions.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port to reach the Eve Flipper UI on. Change if 13370 is already taken on your host.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for the SQLite database (flipper.db), the Static Data Export cache (data/sde/), and the session vault key (.config/EveFlipper/vault_machine.key). Back this up to preserve character logins and history.

Config.Name: ESI Callback URL
Config.Description: Where EVE SSO redirects after login. MUST match the (single) Callback URL registered on developers.eveonline.com for the ESI application you're using. CCP restricts http:// to `localhost` only — non-localhost hosts must use https:// (see DOCKER.md for the reverse-proxy setup). Leave blank to fall back to the baked-in http://localhost:13370/api/auth/callback default.

Config.Name: ESI Client ID
Config.Description: Optional override for the ESI application client ID. Use this when self-hosting behind a second ESI application (different callback URL from the localhost dev one). Leave blank to use the client ID baked into the release build.

Config.Name: ESI Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional override for the ESI application client secret. Set alongside ESI Client ID when using a second ESI application. Leave blank to use the secret baked into the release build.
